candidate_seeds.name: Resonant single-LQ via lepton-parton fusion: flavour/charge extensions beyond e/mu+jet
candidate_seeds.framework: Scalar/vector LQ with lepton content of the proton (LUXlep photon-induced lepton PDFs)
candidate_seeds.idea: Lepton-quark fusion gives single-LQ production that scales with the Yukawa squared and probes large masses at modest couplings. The first LHC searches cover e/mu + light-jet/b-jet and tau+b; extensions (charm/strange tagging, top-containing final states, vector LQ, LQ with LFV couplings, HL-LHC reach) are not obviously covered.
candidate_seeds.signature_hypothesis: Lepton + jet(flavour-tagged: c, b, t-jet) resonance in m(l j); LFV variants (mu-tau, e-mu with q) as lepton+jet resonances; high-mass tails at 13.6 TeV and HL-LHC
